title: This channel needs you
summary: NH explains that a European photographer gave the channel a copyright strike because the thumbnail of his Devon Larratt tribute was a drawing resembling the photographer's photo, then asked for 50 dollars. YouTube rejected NH's counter-claim, even though a lawyer drafted it, and now appears to reject all his counter-claims. He asks viewers to tweet at YouTube under #ProtectYourCreators.
claims: A Japanese company had been sending copyright strikes against his anime videos for two months, and a second company then joined
His Devon Larratt tribute video, which is all him talking, was struck over a drawn thumbnail that resembled a photographer's photo; the photographer demanded 50 dollars
He refused to dox the photographer or turn his audience on him because he opposes doxxing and fanboy weaponisation
YouTube rejected his lawyer-drafted counter-claim and now auto-rejects all his counter-claims, leaving the channel exposed to deletion
The case means any creator can be struck by false manual claims that YouTube does not verify
He asked viewers to tweet at YouTube hourly with #ProtectYourCreators until he regains the ability to contest strikes
He will never bend the knee to censorship or extortion
